entries.title: Unify mobile channel details
entries.rationale: Accept the unified mobile channel-details behavior, but adapt it to Zion's existing modal/card/theme/profile APIs and current import layout. Do not import unrelated prerequisite chains wholesale. Explicitly correct and test non-member Add Members visibility, canvas ownership policy, reconnect behavior, accessibility, and Zion branding.
security_reasons: channel membership and metadata actions affect authorization visibility
open-channel member controls require explicit non-member validation

tracking.implementation_plan: Port combined channel details incrementally after required shared UI prerequisites are reviewed; retain existing Zion profile paths and modal/card components; preserve kinds 9000/9001/9002/9008 and add non-member, role, canvas-policy, reconnect, text-scaling, and rendered mobile tests.

verification: Full-SHA provenance, 61 changed mobile paths, prerequisite/API mismatch, authorization visibility risk, branding, and claimed test coverage reviewed; no source implementation made.
